page.overview:
What is Walking Pokémon?

Walking Pokémon is a mechanic for the Pokémon games introduced in Generation I.

Walking Pokémon are Pokémon that walk alongside the player when they normally would be inside their Poké Balls. Although this mechanic originally occurred only for the Pikachu in , this had later been allowed for all Pokémon since .
